title: Potential path transversal exposure in HlsSegmentController.cs
summary:
### Impact

The request path in HlsSegmentController is not validated to a valid path and could allow escaping the transcode path and downloading of any arbitrary file in GetHlsPlaylistLegacy .

GetHlsAudioSegmentLegacy and GetHlsVideoSegmentLegacy have the same issue, and are NOT behind an Authorize so they are publicly exploitable.
